name: Anger (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Anger (two crossed white keys, a scallop shell and a horseshoe on red).
history: The arms were introduced on the basis of a resolution of the municipal council with the consent of the government of Upper Bavaria, whose letter is dated 30 July 1980; the municipal colours of the flag are white and red.

features.role: Anger arms — keys, shell and horseshoe on red
